products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company, listed on the Nasdaq and TSX under the ticker TRI, that describes itself as delivering technology with purpose to empower professionals in legal, tax, trade, risk, and related fields. Its offerings span legal research, tax and trade compliance, and risk management, with AI woven across those areas. The company publishes annual research on AI adoption, including the Future of Professionals Report 2026 and the 2026 AI in Professional Services Report, the latter drawing on perspectives from more than 1,500 professionals across legal, tax, accounting, risk, fraud, and government sectors.

The company's primary AI product is CoCounsel, described on its site as built on the principles of what Thomson Reuters calls Fiduciary-Grade AI and integrated with Westlaw and Practical Law content for legal research, analysis, and drafting. The site cites a case study in which a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI to increase litigation capacity by 100%. In August 2026 Thomson Reuters announced that global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP had deployed the next generation of CoCounsel Legal, and separately announced the launch of Thomson, described as the company's first proprietary large language model developed in-house. The company also offers ONESOURCE+, an AI-powered platform connecting tax, trade, legal, and risk workflows, and an AI-based Harmonized System code classification tool for trade compliance.

The site's held facts confirm Thomson Reuters is a for-profit public company with SEC CIK number 0001075124. No litigation or MCP server records are present in the available data.
